tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Default page and plate background. The site is white-first.

tokens.name: draft
tokens.usage: Drafting gray: the one tinted ground, for alternating bands and input prefixes. Never two draft bands in a row.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Legacy alias of draft (kept so older components still resolve).

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Legacy alias of draft.

tokens.name: linen
tokens.usage: Legacy alias of line, used only as an image placeholder fill.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines inside plates and tables; the 12-column hero grid. Decorative only.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: List and register dividers. Decorative only, never a control border.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Form control borders (3.2:1 on surface).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text, headings, plate borders and the 1.5px section rules (13.5:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and mono labels (6.9:1 on surface, 6.3:1 on draft).

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Links, secondary buttons, focus ring, the dark closing band (as navy-deep).

tokens.name: navy-deep
tokens.usage: Hover for navy; the closing CTA band and nothing else dark.

tokens.name: on-navy
tokens.usage: Text on navy and navy-deep.

tokens.name: needle
tokens.usage: The primary action only (Find my aircraft, Continue, Start your design in the closing band). Nowhere else: no ticks, bullets, numerals or underlines.

tokens.name: on-needle
tokens.usage: Text on needle (6.6:1).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Registration valid, sent, signed off. Always with words.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero and page titles. Set with font-variation-settings 'wdth' 112. Mobile 42/44.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Interior page titles when the display size is too large. 'wdth' 112.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section headings, ending in a period. 'wdth' 112. Mobile 30/34.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: We pull your aircraft from the FAA registry.
styles.usage: First paragraph under a title. Mobile 17/27.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Every seat comes off and is rebuilt from the frame.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Frames inspected, new foam, perforated leather.
styles.usage: Row descriptions, help text. Never smaller than 14px.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Labels on plates, registers and captions. Sentence case, never uppercase.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Tail numbers, serials, seat counts, dates, prices. Tabular figures.

styles.name: data-lg
styles.usage: The tail number at the top of a data plate; the tail input (24px).

spacing.note: An airy 4px-based scale. Default to the larger step when in doubt.

tokens.name: space-2xs
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Gap between label and input; eyebrow to heading.

tokens.name: space-sm
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons in a row.

tokens.name: space-md
tokens.usage: Paragraph spacing; small card padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-lg
tokens.usage: Grid gutter; heading to body copy.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-2xl
tokens.usage: Gap between a section heading block and its content.

tokens.name: space-3xl
tokens.usage: Section padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-4xl
tokens.usage: Feature section padding on desktop (88px for supporting sections).

tokens.name: space-5xl
tokens.usage: Hero top and bottom padding on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, buttons, segmented controls.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons (same as radius-sm).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Plates. Photos and the wiper are square-cornered (0).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: The wiper grip and portrait-free status dots only.

tokens.name: shadow-soft
tokens.usage: Offset plate: one featured plate per page (job file). Otherwise depth comes from 1px ink borders.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: The wiper grip.

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Max width including 32px side padding (20px on mobile); 12-column grid.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max width of running text blocks.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Header bar height on desktop (64px on mobile).
